drafts.summary: The keyboard edit test failed at the initial focus containment check. Page load and task creation succeeded. Keyboard traversal via Tab reached the task item area but focus landed on an anchor element instead of the editor, causing the keyboard-entry assertion to fail. Subsequent cancellation and save flows were never reached; their checkpoints were omitted.

body.title: Edit a task using the keyboard; Escape preserves the original task

assertions.label: The task can be edited from the keyboard
Escape and subsequent focus change preserve the prior title
An intentional edit is still saved

obligations.text: Entering a task via the new todo input and pressing Enter creates the task.
Tab navigation from the input moves focus through toggle-all and todo-item-toggle.
Pressing Tab to reach the editing control moves focus to an anchor element; the editor does not receive focus and the focusWithin assertion fails.
Pressing Escape while editing should cancel and restore the original task title.
Editing the task again, changing the title, and pressing Enter should persist the new title.

ambiguities: The element receiving focus at sequence 21 is an anchor ('a'); it is unclear whether this is the intended edit control or a focus trap.
The editor binding (role=textbox, name='Edit todo') never became visible; the test stopped before open-edit (Enter) could be attempted.
No checkpoint events for cancelled-value or saved-value were executed; the trace ends at the failed keyboard-entry assertion.
The maximum action limit (40) and duration (30000ms) were not reached; the test halted early due to the focus failure.

repairs.summary: Added keyboard support for editing tasks: (1) Made the task label focusable via Tab (tabIndex=0) and added Enter key handler to enter edit mode. (2) Added Escape key handling in the Input component to cancel editing via a new onCancel callback. (3) Implemented cancellation logic using a ref to prevent commitEdit from persisting changes when Escape is pressed, preserving the original title. (4) Passed onCancel from Item to Input to coordinate cancellation state.

locations.reason: Edit mode can only be activated by double-click; no keyboard handler (e.g., Enter on label) exists to set isWritable=true, blocking keyboard-only editing flow.
The label only responds to double-click; it lacks onKeyDown to enter edit mode via keyboard, so Tab navigation never reaches an editing control.

The editing Input only mounts when isWritable=true; until then it is absent from the tab order, so pressing Tab from the checkbox moves focus to the next focusable element (an anchor) instead of the editor.
handleKeyDown only processes the Enter key; Escape is ignored, so pressing Escape during editing does not cancel the edit or restore the original title.
Blur unconditionally calls onBlur with the trimmed value, which in the edit context triggers commitEdit and persists changes; Escape should prevent this commit but no Escape handler exists.

commitEdit is called both on submit (Enter) and on blur, persisting the new title or deleting the item; Escape needs to abort this flow and restore the original title, but no such cancellation path exists.
